correctness.rationale: F_n=K_1 join P_n, n>=2. In the no-spoke matching complex A=Ind(P_{n-1}), each spoke-cone attaches along Ind(P_{i-2})*Ind(P_{n-i-1}); the path recurrence Ind(P_j)≃Sigma Ind(P_{j-3}) gives all link types. At n=3k links are spheres one dimension below A and maps null; at n=3k+1 the first spoke has link-to-A equivalence and kills A; at n=3k+2 A contractible. Residue counts yield respectively (k+1) spheres dimension k-1, k spheres dimension k, and (2k+2) spheres dimension k. n=2,3 have 3 components and the formal S^{-1} joining convention is handled separately. Independent direct mod-two boundary calculation for ALL n=2..11 agreed with reduced Betti rank/dimension; those finite checks do not establish the all-n proof.

value.rationale: Fan graphs are natural maximal outerplanar triangulations and matching complexes are fundamental topology-of-graphs invariants. The explicit all-n integral homotopy degree/multiplicity, torsion-freeness, and mod-three regime supply structural information absent from a generic wedge-of-spheres theorem; the spoke-inclusion equivalence at residue one is a nonroutine topological step. This result can serve as a benchmark for outerplanar matching-complex refinements.

limitations: Ordinary nonequivariant matching complexes of K1∨Pn for n>=2 only; not PL homeomorphism or general outerplanar exact formula.
